scope: Tags are checked against final constructed tasks, not original template intent. Semantic target values continue to be checked independently.
All equal-route checks enumerate feasible simple routes. Positive costs ensure shortest routes are simple; arbitrary cyclic equal-length walks are excluded.
The ordinal predicate tags are opaque producer strata and are not assigned an invented meaning.
The immutable pilot release is read only; errata live in separate review/audit files.
Initial blind verdicts were frozen before another reviewer finding topic was disclosed. This supplemental tag audit is independently reproduced but informed by that challenge.
